description: Security tightening: the owner login is now truly mandatory (the old loopback bypass that let funnel visitors straight into the console is narrowed to the gateway's own 3 POST endpoints), and the server binds localhost only — remote access goes exclusively through the login-gated Tailscale funnel.
features: Fixed auth bypass: loopback requests now need a session like everyone else (gateway keeps POST api/chat_stream|answer|cancel only) — every browser visit lands on login.html until sign-in.
Server binds 127.0.0.1 everywhere (install --run, x5agent, scripts): localhost only, never a public bind; funnel still proxies to it.
Report Local line is the loopback URL; remote opens only via the funnel public URL.
Version synced to 0.11.0 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
